dogecoin.text:
I haven't been playing a lot of games lately. So instead of letting my GPU gather dust, I did some casual mining on it — just something to add to my portfolio.

Now I have a wonky fraction of $doge. Never thought I could get fractions of it. Before mining, it was a whole number. https://t.co/CR0GMo35ei

The thought about accepting $doge as tips sounds interesting and fun to me.

As one who enjoys a good sci-fi story, I can imagine a world where physical money no longer exists. Instead, one would transfer cash on a digital blockchain or physical flash drives.
